visualCharacteristics: New: no vertical borders, 1px horizontal rules between rows, optional bold header row with a heavier rule beneath (plain "table"); the source "no-header" option is the same look without the header row, so it maps to this variant with the no-header option.
contentPattern: Tabular data; each table is its own block, the headings between them stay default content.

usage.description: Light data table with horizontal row rules only; the first row is a bold header unless the no-header option is set (name lists, honour rolls).

reuseGuidance: Use for simple lists and schedules. Add (no-header) when every row is data, e.g. name lists. Use table-bordered when a full cell grid is needed.
tableStructure: First row: header cells (omit by naming the block Table Row Lines (no-header)). Following rows: one data row each, one cell per column; empty cells are allowed
